content:
have a PR adding spherical arcs to Mathlib/Geometry/Euclidean/Sphere (#34164). It's now ~1000 lines, so I'd like input on how to split it before going further.

Splitting: I'd like to extract orthRadius/lineOrOrthRadius into a separate prerequisite PR, since the arc file only imports it. The arc file itself could also be split into definitions + dimension‑free API vs. 2‑dimensional theory, but I'm not sure if that seam is clean. @Joseph Myers , since you've been reviewing this, would you prefer one PR or split? If split, where would you cut? I don't want to fragment your review.

Thanks!
Splitting out the changes to an existing file seems reasonable. I don't think the new file needs to be split.
